content.text: Did last month's latency spike come from the new reranker, and is it fixed?

Smaller inference batches and a candidate embedding cache for ranking

Fixes INC-4821, a regression from PR 1187. Reranker v2 with batch size 64 queued requests behind each other under peak load, which pushed tail latency up. This PR rolls the batch size back to 16 and adds an LRU cache for candidate embeddings so repeat queries skip the encoder. Load test: p95 back to 175 ms at 2x peak traffic. Deployed with search-api v4.12.2.

content.text:
search-api v4.12

Rolled out search-api v4.12 to production (canary 10% at 16:05, full at 17:30 UTC). Changes: cross-encoder ranking now serves all search traffic, reranker v2 flag default on (PR 1187); bumps the protobuf library; drops the unused legacy facets endpoint. Canary checks passed on error rate. Rollback plan: previous image v4.11.3.

search-api weekly SLO report, week 38

Week of Sept 14–20. p95 was 610 ms Monday to Thursday morning, above the 300 ms SLO; from Sept 18 afternoon p95 dropped to 176 ms and stayed at baseline through Sunday. p50 98 ms for the week. Availability 99.95%. Error budget: 38% used this week.

hits.rationale: Reports a latency spike in week 38 that dropped later.

content.text:
search-api p95 elevated across all regions

Opened by on-call (Priya Raman) at 09:12 UTC after the SLO burn alert fired. search-api p95 latency climbed from ~180 ms to ~640 ms starting early Sept 14 and is holding there. p50 is only slightly up. Error rate is flat, so requests succeed but slowly. CPU on the search-api pods is up ~35%. Checked the CDN and the edge cache: both look normal. No config pushes in the last 12 hours. Mitigation so far: scaled search-api from 24 to 36 pods, which took p95 down to ~520 ms but did not clear it. Root cause: not yet identified. Leaving open for the search team to investigate on Monday. Customer impact: slower search results pages, some timeouts on the mobile app's type-ahead.

metadata.title: search-api p95 elevated across all regions

hits.rationale: Describes search-api p95 latency spike in mid-September (INC-4821).

content.text:
Roll out reranker v2 to all search traffic

This turns on reranker v2 (the cross-encoder model) for 100% of search requests, up from the 5% experiment. Offline NDCG@10 is +4.1% over v1. Batch size is set to 64 to keep GPU utilisation high. Rollout is behind the reranker_v2 flag so we can turn it off. Reviewers: @lortiz @pramam.

Week of Aug 17–23. p95 spiked to 880 ms on Aug 21 for EU traffic, otherwise 180 ms. Availability 99.93%. Error budget: 22% used.

search-api pod autoscaling limits

Raised the search-api horizontal pod autoscaler max from 24 to 40 pods. Infra-only change, no new image.

search-api weekly SLO report, week 39

Week of Sept 21–27. p50 95 ms, p95 179 ms, p99 400 ms. Availability 99.97%. All SLOs met. Type-ahead suggestion freshness alert fired on Sept 22.

search-api weekly SLO report, week 40

Week of Sept 28–Oct 4. p50 94 ms, p95 183 ms, p99 415 ms. Availability 99.98%.

Search results slow for EU shoppers

Customers in the EU reported slow search pages from 14:00 UTC. search-api p95 latency rose to ~900 ms for EU traffic only. Traced to a CDN configuration change that removed the regional cache rule for /search, so every request went to origin. Rolled back the CDN change at 15:40 UTC and p95 returned to normal within 10 minutes. Root cause: CDN config change (change ticket CHG-2231). Follow-up: add the cache rule to the CDN config tests.
